purpose: Correct AC1024+ LTYPE group-74 bit interpretation and text-area presence using ODA wire semantics and an externally sourced AutoCAD SAVEAS 2010 sample.

authorities.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
findings: Shapeflag bit 0x02 means the complex shapecode is an index into the text area.
Shapeflag bit 0x04 means the complex shapecode is a shape number.
R2007+ adds the 512-byte text area only when bit 0x02 is set on any Shapeflag.
DXF group 74 bit 0x02 means embedded text and bit 0x04 means embedded shape.

sample.source_profile: The bundled AutoLISP script requests SAVEAS 2010 to create sample_AC1024.dwg; the exact host executable/release and execution receipt are not recorded, so this is not an AutoCAD 2010 RTM witness.

changes: DWG LTYPE shape flags now retain ODA/DXF group-74 bit meanings instead of swapping bits 0x02 and 0x04.
R2007+ string-area parsing now keys on embedded-text bit 0x02; shape-only bit 0x04 records consume no text area.

after.strict_dxf_output: refused before output preparation at unsupported AcDbTableContent replay; no output was published

validation.asan_build_and_ctest: cmake --build build-asan-custom --target dwg2dxf libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --parallel 4; ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R 'dwg_ltype_text_area_contract|dwg_object_vectors$' --output-on-failure
validation.asan_physical_sample: dwg2dxf parsed the sample with operationSucceeded=true, zero entity/object parse failures, and no AddressSanitizer report; process exit 1 was the expected strict refusal of standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA replay.

scope: This fixes and source-qualifies LTYPE shape/text flag decoding for this AC1024 producer profile. It does not qualify TABLECONTENT output, complete drawing conversion, native linetype rendering, or AutoCAD 2010 RTM CLASSES behavior.
